title: The outer-pedal area centroid in even-period elliptic billiards
description: We prove the k307 outer-side pedal area-centroid observation of Reznik, Garcia and Koiller for billiards in a noncircular ellipse with a strict confocal elliptic caustic and least even period. The ordered perpendicular feet of any fixed point on the boundary tangent lines have an explicit phase-independent signed area centroid wherever their signed area is nonzero. We classify the entire zero-area locus: none when d is nonnegative, and a fixed circle when d is negative. Simple winding-one even families have a centroid for every fixed point; the four-period value is M/3. An exact primitive eight-period star shows that the exceptional undefined locus is real. The note supplies an all-period support-coordinate and cubic-moment proof. The verification archive contains the LaTeX source, exact symbolic and rational certificates, independent high-precision orbit controls, audit reports and reproducibility instructions. The original observation and classical methods are credited. Bounded primary-source audits found no earlier covering proof, without certifying historical firstness. AI tools were used extensively in solving, verifying, literature research, writing and adversarial review. This is an unrefereed preprint and has not received external human peer review or proof-assistant formalization.
